```{r}
# ============================================================
# GO enrichment des OG significatifs branch-site codeml
# Unité statistique = orthogroup (OG), pas transcript/gène
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(GO.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Paramètres
# -----------------------------

fasta_dir <- "/Volumes/Trystan/Lyon/M2/Stage/6_codeml/Single_Copy_Orthologue_Sequences"
agat_dir  <- "/Volumes/Trystan/Lyon/M2/Stage/AGAT"

outdir <- "/Volumes/Trystan/Lyon/M2/Stage/Gene_enrichment/output_branchsite_GO"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sig_OG <- c(
  "OG0004663",
  "OG0005016",
  "OG0004877",
  "OG0003851",
  "OG0004649"
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Lire les headers FASTA des OG
# -----------------------------

read_og_fasta_headers <- function(f) {
  og <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  
  headers <- readLines(f)
  headers <- headers[grepl("^>", headers)]
  headers <- sub("^>", "", headers)
  
  tibble(
    OG = og,
    header = headers
  ) %>%
    tidyr::separate(
      header,
      into = c("species", "transcript"),
      sep = "\\|",
      remove = FALSE
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      gene_id = paste0(species, "|", transcript)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}

fasta_files <- list.files(
  fasta_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fa$|\\.fasta$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

OG2genes <- bind_rows(lapply(fasta_files, read_og_fasta_headers)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# -----------------------------
# 3. Lire les GO depuis les GFF AGAT
# -----------------------------

get_attr <- function(attr, key) {
  pattern <- paste0("(^|;)", key, "=([^;]+)")
  stringr::str_match(attr, pattern)[, 3]
}

read_gff_GO <- function(gff_path) {
  species <- basename(dirname(gff_path))
  
  gff <- suppressWarnings(
    read.delim(
      gff_path,
      sep = "\t",
      header = FALSE,
      comment.char = "#",
      quote = "",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      col.names = c(
        "seqid", "source", "type", "start", "end",
        "score", "strand", "phase", "attributes"
      )
    )
  )
  
  gff %>%
    dplyr::filter(type == "mRNA") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      transcript = get_attr(attributes, "ID"),
      go_raw = get_attr(attributes, "Ontology_term"),
      gene_id = paste0(species, "|", transcript)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(go_raw), go_raw != "", go_raw != "-") %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(go_raw, sep = ",") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      term = stringr::str_extract(go_raw, "GO:[0-9]+")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(term)) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, term) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
}

gff_files <- list.files(
  agat_dir,
  pattern = "\\.gff$|\\.gff3$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

TERM2GENE_transcripts <- bind_rows(lapply(gff_files, read_gff_GO)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# -----------------------------
# 4. Convertir GO-transcrits vers GO-OG
# -----------------------------

OG_GO <- OG2genes %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(TERM2GENE_transcripts, by = "gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(OG, species, transcript, term) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

TERM2OG <- OG_GO %>%
  dplyr::select(term, OG) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# -----------------------------
# 5. Construire TERM2NAME avec GO.db
# -----------------------------

GO_names_all <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(TERM2OG$term),
  keytype = "GOID",
  columns = c("GOID", "TERM", "ONTOLOGY")
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(GOID, TERM, ONTOLOGY) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TERM), TERM != "") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    term = GOID,
    name = paste0(TERM, " [", ONTOLOGY, "]")
  )

GO_names_clean <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(TERM2OG$term),
  keytype = "GOID",
  columns = c("GOID", "TERM", "ONTOLOGY")
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(GOID, TERM, ONTOLOGY) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TERM), TERM != "") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    term = GOID,
    GO_name = TERM,
    GO_ontology = ONTOLOGY
  )

# -----------------------------
# 6. Définir l'univers et les OG significatifs avec GO
# -----------------------------

universe_OG <- sort(unique(TERM2OG$OG))
sig_OG_with_GO <- intersect(sig_OG, universe_OG)
sig_OG_without_GO <- setdiff(sig_OG, universe_OG)

cat("Nombre total d'OG dans les FASTA :", length(unique(OG2genes$OG)), "\n")
cat("Nombre d'OG avec au moins un GO :", length(universe_OG), "\n")
cat("Nombre d'OG branch-site significatifs :", length(sig_OG), "\n")
cat("Nombre d'OG branch-site significatifs avec GO :", length(sig_OG_with_GO), "\n")
cat("OG branch-site sans GO :", paste(sig_OG_without_GO, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# -----------------------------
# 7. Table descriptive des GO des 5 OG branch-site
# -----------------------------

branchsite_GO_table <- OG_GO %>%
  dplyr::filter(OG %in% sig_OG) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(GO_names_clean, by = "term") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(OG, term, GO_name, GO_ontology) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_species_annotated = dplyr::n_distinct(species),
    species = paste(sort(unique(species)), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(OG, GO_ontology, term)

write.csv(
  branchsite_GO_table,
  file.path(outdir, "branchsite_5OG_GO_annotation_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# -----------------------------
# 8. Enrichissement GO au niveau OG
# -----------------------------

ego_branchsite <- enricher(
  gene = sig_OG_with_GO,
  universe = universe_OG,
  TERM2GENE = TERM2OG,
  TERM2NAME = GO_names_all,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 1,
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  minGSSize = 2,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

ego_branchsite_df <- as.data.frame(ego_branchsite)

write.csv(
  ego_branchsite_df,
  file.path(outdir, "GO_enrichment_branchsite_5OG_vs_all_codeml_OG.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

ego_branchsite_sig <- ego_branchsite_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.05)

write.csv(
  ego_branchsite_sig,
  file.path(outdir, "GO_enrichment_branchsite_5OG_qvalue005.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# -----------------------------
# 9. Dotplot si enrichissement disponible
# -----------------------------

if (nrow(ego_branchsite_df) > 0) {
  p_branchsite <- dotplot(ego_branchsite, showCategory = 20)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, "GO_dotplot_branchsite_5OG.png"),
    plot = p_branchsite,
    dpi = 300,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 10. Résumés utiles à afficher
# -----------------------------

cat("\nNombre de GO uniques par OG branch-site :\n")

print(
  TERM2OG %>%
    dplyr::filter(OG %in% sig_OG) %>%
    dplyr::count(OG, name = "n_unique_GO") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(OG)
)

cat("\nTop résultats enrichissement GO :\n")

print(
  ego_branchsite_df %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue, geneID, Count) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    head(20)
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(clusterProfiler)

# -----------------------------
# Préparer les résultats significatifs
# -----------------------------

ego_plot_df <- ego_branchsite_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Description_clean = stringr::str_remove(Description, " \\[[A-Z]+\\]$"),
    Ontology = stringr::str_extract(Description, "\\[[A-Z]+\\]$"),
    Ontology = stringr::str_remove_all(Ontology, "\\[|\\]"),
    minus_log10_qvalue = -log10(qvalue),
    Description_clean = forcats::fct_reorder(Description_clean, minus_log10_qvalue)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 1. Dotplot clusterProfiler
# -----------------------------

p_dot <- dotplot(
  ego_branchsite,
  showCategory = 100,
  x = "GeneRatio",
  color = "qvalue"
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("GO enrichment of branch-site significant orthogroups") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "GO_dotplot_branchsite_qvalue005.png"),
  plot = p_dot,
  dpi = 300,
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Barplot custom : -log10(qvalue)
# -----------------------------

p_bar <- ggplot(
  ego_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Description_clean,
    y = minus_log10_qvalue,
    fill = Ontology
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "GO enrichment of branch-site significant orthogroups",
    x = "GO term",
    y = "-log10(q-value)",
    fill = "Ontology"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "GO_barplot_branchsite_qvalue005.png"),
  plot = p_bar,
  dpi = 300,
  width = 9,
  height = 7
)

# Afficher les plots dans RStudio
p_dot
p_bar
```

```{r}
gerromorpha_species <- c(
  "Hermatobates_lingyangjiaoensis",
  "Microvelia_longipes",
  "Tetraripis_zetteli",
  "Rhagovelia_antilleana",
  "Gigantometra_gigas",
  "Aquarius_najas",
  "Aquarius_paludum",
  "Gerris_buenoi",
  "Gerris_lacustris",
  "Gerris_odontogaster"
)

# GO associés uniquement aux séquences Gerromorpha
OG_GO_gerro <- OG_GO %>%
  dplyr::filter(species %in% gerromorpha_species) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

TERM2OG_gerro <- OG_GO_gerro %>%
  dplyr::select(term, OG) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# Background = tous les OG codeml ayant au moins un GO chez Gerromorpha
universe_OG_gerro <- sort(unique(TERM2OG_gerro$OG))

# Foreground = les 5 OG branch-site ayant au moins un GO chez Gerromorpha
sig_OG_with_GO_gerro <- intersect(sig_OG, universe_OG_gerro)

GO_names_gerro <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(TERM2OG_gerro$term),
  keytype = "GOID",
  columns = c("GOID", "TERM", "ONTOLOGY")
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(GOID, TERM, ONTOLOGY) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TERM), TERM != "") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    term = GOID,
    name = paste0(TERM, " [", ONTOLOGY, "]")
  )

ego_branchsite_gerro <- enricher(
  gene = sig_OG_with_GO_gerro,
  universe = universe_OG_gerro,
  TERM2GENE = TERM2OG_gerro,
  TERM2NAME = GO_names_gerro,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 1,
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  minGSSize = 2,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

ego_branchsite_gerro_df <- as.data.frame(ego_branchsite_gerro)

ego_branchsite_gerro_df %>%
  dplyr::arrange(qvalue) %>%
  head(20)
```
